messages.author: 1f454cd740ef9a11
messages.subject: AIC
parts:
Hi. Can I compare AIC from unmarkedFrameGDS() and unmarkedFrameDS to
select the best model fit?

Thank you
Jose

messages.author: 681fb59733e01a1e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] AIC
parts:
hi Jose,
 I recommend comparing exactly the same model using both functions to make sure the likelihood scalings are the same. If so then the answer is yes for the T=1 primary period situations.
 If your intent is to compare T>1 with T=1 cases then I don't think you can do that.
regards
andy

messages.author: 527e14923215b7e4
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] AIC
parts:
Hi Jose,

The likelihoods are scaled differently, so you cannot compare them using AIC. I recommend using gdistsamp instead of distsamp if speed isn't an issue, and if you don't mind that there aren't as many methods to produce histograms and such things.

Richard
